methodology: One pass per engine/input in a fresh browser. Identical output pixel budget, sequential pages, no page raster cache, page resources released between pages. PDFium uses the current hybrid adapter (PDF.js metadata remains); raster time includes worker transport and canvas presentation. First frame includes lazy WASM initialization/document import. No repeated-run means or energy claims. Process memory is summed over this browser process tree at three checkpoints; sampled maximum is not a true peak. CPU time includes document setup and browser work.
